findings.title: Undo during a slider gesture saves the value that was just undone
findings.trigger: Begin a slider gesture, set Exposure from 0 to +1, invoke undo before the gesture sink closes, end gesture, quit.
findings.effect: In-memory exposure remains 0, but test.png.xmp contains exposure:1. Negative control: close gesture before undo; sidecar correctly omits the non-default exposure. Slider release and prepareToQuit flush pendingGesturePersist without replacing it with the undo result.
findings.latestStatus: persists by source comparison; apply/flush logic unchanged
findings.direction: Make undo/redo and pending gesture persistence one ordered state transition; regression-test memory, catalog and XMP after release and reopen.

findings.confidence: source plus exact arithmetic replay; native gesture not verified
findings.title: Panel resizing accumulates the full gesture translation repeatedly
findings.trigger: Drag the Develop column divider left while several onChanged events arrive.
findings.effect: The current, already modified width is reduced by cumulative drag.translation.width. From 380 pt, events −2,−4,−6,−8,−10 produce 410 instead of 390 pt; ten 1-pt-spaced events produce 435. The outcome depends on event count. Coordinate-based GUI dragging was unavailable in the audit tool, so this is not claimed as a live gesture reproduction.
findings.latestStatus: persists; same closure on latest branch
findings.direction: Capture the starting width and use a stable coordinate space; apply each cumulative translation to the start, not the current width.

findings.confidence: source and native accessibility tree observed
findings.title: Custom editing sliders do not expose adjustable accessibility semantics
findings.trigger: Inspect Develop or local-mask editing with native accessibility APIs.
findings.effect: Tone and other sliders appear as merged static text, for example 'Tone Exposure 0.00 Contrast 0 …', without per-control slider roles or increment/decrement actions. The standard thumbnail-size slider is correctly exposed as settable float. Keyboard arrow handlers exist, but are not a substitute for each slider's accessible name/value/adjust action.
findings.latestStatus: persists by source comparison; no slider accessibility modifiers added
findings.direction: Expose individual labelled adjustable elements and numeric values, then test VoiceOver navigation and value changes on a real build.

findings.confidence: exact new-branch algorithm replay plus production catalog reproduction
findings.title: Opening selected files from sibling trees can merge two photographs into one catalog identity
findings.trigger: Select /audit/day1/photos/DSC_0001.NEF and /audit/day2/photos/DSC_0001.NEF using the newer multi-file Open workflow.
findings.effect: commonParent collects every equal path component, even after a mismatch, producing /audit/photos instead of /audit. ScannedFile.catalogName falls back to basename because neither file is below the fake root. Both become DSC_0001.NEF in one folder row; the catalog probe returns the same ID twice and one row. Saving exposure −2 for the second changes the first's current recipe from +1 to −2.
findings.latestStatus: new in latest branch a6e6941; multi-file workflow absent on main
findings.direction: Stop common-prefix comparison at the first mismatch. Reject out-of-root catalog paths rather than collapsing to basename; assert distinct identity for every selected original.

findings.confidence: new-branch call-path review plus production catalog reproduction
findings.title: Opening a selected subset marks unselected photographs as missing
findings.trigger: Scan a folder of photographs, then use the newer Open-selected-files workflow to open only one file from that same folder.
findings.effect: The selected subset is passed to the full-folder reconciliation API. Other existing rows are marked missing, although their originals remain on disk. Core reproduction: two-photo album becomes a one-photo visible album after a one-file scan; missingIDs contains the unselected file. Reopening the full folder repairs the missing state. No original is deleted.
findings.latestStatus: new latest-branch caller misuse of unchanged catalog API; main has no selected-subset caller
findings.direction: Separate register/update-selected-files from complete-folder reconciliation. Only a complete enumeration may declare an absent row missing.
